newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore oil export trade down 4.8 pct in Feb - TDB.
newsitem.headline: Singapore oil export trade down 4.8 pct in Feb - TDB.

text.p: The value of Singapore's domestic oil exports fell a nominal 4.8 percent in the year to February to Singapore $1.206 billion after a 7.6 percent year-on-year rise in January, the Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Thursday.
The nominal value fell 22 percent in February from January's $1.538 billion.
In real terms, oil exports fell 15 percent in February to $1.56 billion after sliding just 0.7 percent in January.
"This was due to both the moderation of oil prices with the end of winter and lower demand in key markets such as China and Hong Kong," the TDB said in a statement.
